function.arguments: {"index": 4, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The `channel` variable is not randomly assigned — the email campaign was deliberately targeted at existing high-value customers (loyal and returning segments), which leads to a systematic imbalance in `customer_segment` between channels. A raw comparison of conversion rates would be confounded by this imbalance. To isolate the campaign effect, I computed conditional conversion rates within each `customer_segment` and then computed a weighted average difference, using the segment distribution within each channel as weights. This method adjusts for the confounding by `customer_segment` and provides a valid estimate of the campaign's effect on conversion rates."}
